description: This file contains unit tests and debug functions for AVL Tree data structure, including inserting, sorting, traversing, and finding min/max elements, specifically testing the avlTree implementation using integers.

classes.name: AVLTree<int,int>
classes.description: Generic AVL Tree implementation for integer key-value pairs with methods for insertion, sorting, traversal, and min/max retrieval.

classes.name: AVLNode<int,int>
classes.description: Node within the AVL Tree, holding key, value, and count.

classes.name: AVLTreeInOrderIterator<int,int>
classes.description: Iterator to traverse AVL Tree nodes in order (ascending or descending).

methods.name: int printArray(int * intArray,int arrayLength)
methods.description: Prints the contents of an integer array with its size.

methods.name: int insertInArray(AVLTree<int,int> & avlTree,int * intArray,int arrayLength)
methods.description: Inserts array elements into AVL Tree and checks for insertion success, duplicates, and iterator correctness.

methods.name: int sortAndPrint(AVLTree<int,int> & avlTree,int arrayLength,bool asc)
methods.description: Sorts the AVL Tree elements in specified order and prints them.

methods.name: int traverseAndPrint(AVLTree<int,int> & avlTree,bool forward)
methods.description: Traverses the AVL Tree inorder, forwards or backwards, and prints elements.

methods.name: int minmaxAndPrint(AVLTree<int,int> & avlTree)
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the minimum and maximum elements in the AVL Tree.

methods.name: int avlintTests(int testCase,AVLTree<int,int> & avlTree,int * intArray,int arrayLength)
methods.description: Runs a series of tests including insertion, sorting, traversal, and min/max on the AVL Tree.

methods.name: int testavlint2()
methods.description: Main function executing multiple test cases to validate AVL Tree operations with different datasets.

ctags.name: avlintTests
ctags.pattern: /^int avlintTests(int testCase, AVLTree<int,int> &avlTree, int *intArray, int arrayLength)$/
